title: Ternary operator for conditional rendering
question: How do you use the ternary operator for conditional rendering in React?
searchIntent: how to conditionally render in react
realWorldScenario: `{isLoggedIn ? <Dashboard /> : <Login />}` is the standard pattern for auth-gated content.

title: Short-circuit (&&) rendering
question: How does the `&&` short-circuit operator work for conditional rendering and what is a common pitfall?
realWorldScenario: The pitfall: `{0 && <Component />}` renders `0` to the screen instead of nothing — use `{count > 0 && <Component />}` instead.

title: if/else outside JSX
question: Why can't you use `if/else` statements directly inside JSX and how do you handle complex conditions?
searchIntent: can you use if else in jsx react
realWorldScenario: Complex conditions go before the return statement; JSX only accepts expressions, not statements.

title: null renders nothing
question: What values can a React component return to render nothing and which values accidentally render unexpected output?
seoKeywords: react null undefined false renders nothing
searchIntent: what returns nothing in react jsx
realWorldScenario: `null`, `undefined`, and `false` render nothing; `0` and `''` do render (the number/empty string).
